## Data

```{r}
#| label: data

library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)

all_null_perf <- read.csv("all_null_perf.csv")
all_upper_bounds <- read.csv("all_upper_bounds_95%.csv")
all_upper_bounds_max <- read.csv("all_upper_bounds_max.csv")

nba_full <- read.csv("full_1_57_dperf.csv")
nba_full <- nba_full %>%
  filter(game_time_min <= 48)


dperf_cols <- names(nba_full)[grepl("^dPerf_", names(nba_full))]


players <- names(nba_full) %>%
  str_subset("^Perf_") %>%
  str_remove("^Perf_")

filter_player_games <- function(data, player, threshold = 10){

  dperf_col <- paste0("dPerf_", player)

  data %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    filter(sum(abs(.data[[dperf_col]]), na.rm = TRUE) > threshold) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

## Plot Simulated and real games with 95% Bound

```{r}
#| label: get real game data
real_long <- map_dfr(players, function(p) {

  perf_col  <- paste0("Perf_", p)
  dperf_col <- paste0("dPerf_", p)

  nba_full %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    filter(sum(abs(.data[[dperf_col]]), na.rm = TRUE) > 10) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(game_id, game_time_min, !!sym(perf_col)) %>%
    rename(obs_perf = !!sym(perf_col)) %>%
    mutate(player = p) %>%
    filter(!is.na(obs_perf))
})
```

```{r}
#| label: plot simulated games
for (p in players) {

  p_null  <- all_null_perf %>% filter(player == p)
  p_bound <- all_upper_bounds %>% filter(player == p)

  print(
    ggplot() +
      geom_step(
        data = p_null,
        aes(x = game_time_min, y = sim_Perf, group = sim_game),
        alpha = 0.22,
        linewidth = 0.5,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = p_bound,
        aes(x = game_time_min, y = upper_line),
        linewidth = 0.8,
        color = "red"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = paste("Simulated Null Games with Upper Bound:", p),
        x = "Game Time (Minutes)",
        y = "Performance"
      )
  )
}
```

## Heat Area

```{r}
#| label: heat area function for real games

detect_heat_intervals_with_area_compact <- function(player_name, real_long, all_upper_bounds,
                                                    digits = 1, area_digits = 2) {

  bound_df <- all_upper_bounds %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  player_games <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    distinct(game_id)

  blocks <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_id, game_time_min) %>%
    mutate(
      upper_line = approx(
        x = bound_df$game_time_min,
        y = bound_df$upper_line,
        xout = game_time_min,
        rule = 2
      )$y,
      excess = obs_perf - upper_line,
      above = excess > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    mutate(
      block = cumsum(above != lag(above, default = first(above))),
      dt = game_time_min - lag(game_time_min),
      trap = ifelse(
        above & lag(above, default = FALSE),
        ((excess + lag(excess, default = 0)) / 2) * dt,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(above) %>%
    group_by(game_id, block) %>%
    summarise(
      t_in = min(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      t_out = max(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      area = sum(trap, na.rm = TRUE),
      duration = t_out - t_in,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_in = round(t_in, digits),
      t_out = round(t_out, digits),
      area = round(area, area_digits),
      duration = round(duration, 2),
      interval = paste0(t_in, "–", t_out)
    )

  heat_summary <- blocks %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_intervals = n(),
      intervals = paste(interval, collapse = "; "),
      areas = paste(area, collapse = "; "),
      durations = paste(duration, collapse = "; "),
      total_heat_area = round(sum(area), area_digits),
      total_heat_time = round(sum(duration), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  player_games %>%
    left_join(heat_summary, by = "game_id") %>%
    mutate(
      n_intervals = ifelse(is.na(n_intervals), 0L, n_intervals),
      intervals = ifelse(is.na(intervals), "", intervals),
      areas = ifelse(is.na(areas), "", areas),
      durations = ifelse(is.na(durations), "", durations),
      total_heat_area = ifelse(is.na(total_heat_area), 0, total_heat_area),
      total_heat_time = ifelse(is.na(total_heat_time), 0, total_heat_time)
    ) %>%
    arrange(game_id)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: heat area function for simulated games

detect_heat_intervals_with_area_compact_null <- function(player_name, all_null_perf, all_upper_bounds,
                                                         digits = 1, area_digits = 2) {

  bound_df <- all_upper_bounds %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  sim_games <- all_null_perf %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    distinct(sim_game)

  blocks <- all_null_perf %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(sim_game, game_time_min) %>%
    mutate(
      upper_line = approx(
        x = bound_df$game_time_min,
        y = bound_df$upper_line,
        xout = game_time_min,
        rule = 2
      )$y,
      excess = sim_Perf - upper_line,
      above = excess > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(sim_game) %>%
    mutate(
      block = cumsum(above != lag(above, default = first(above))),
      dt = game_time_min - lag(game_time_min),
      trap = ifelse(
        above & lag(above, default = FALSE),
        ((excess + lag(excess, default = 0)) / 2) * dt,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(above) %>%
    group_by(sim_game, block) %>%
    summarise(
      t_in = min(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      t_out = max(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      area = sum(trap, na.rm = TRUE),
      duration = t_out - t_in,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_in = round(t_in, digits),
      t_out = round(t_out, digits),
      area = round(area, area_digits),
      duration = round(duration, 2),
      interval = paste0(t_in, "–", t_out)
    )

  heat_summary <- blocks %>%
    group_by(sim_game) %>%
    summarise(
      n_intervals = n(),
      intervals = paste(interval, collapse = "; "),
      areas = paste(area, collapse = "; "),
      durations = paste(duration, collapse = "; "),
      total_heat_area = round(sum(area), area_digits),
      total_heat_time = round(sum(duration), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  sim_games %>%
    left_join(heat_summary, by = "sim_game") %>%
    mutate(
      n_intervals = ifelse(is.na(n_intervals), 0L, n_intervals),
      intervals = ifelse(is.na(intervals), "", intervals),
      areas = ifelse(is.na(areas), "", areas),
      durations = ifelse(is.na(durations), "", durations),
      total_heat_area = ifelse(is.na(total_heat_area), 0, total_heat_area),
      total_heat_time = ifelse(is.na(total_heat_time), 0, total_heat_time)
    ) %>%
    arrange(sim_game)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: heat table null
heat_tables_null <- map_dfr(players, function(p) {

  detect_heat_intervals_with_area_compact_null(
    player_name = p,
    all_null_perf = all_null_perf,
    all_upper_bounds = all_upper_bounds
  ) %>%
    mutate(player = p) %>%
    select(player, everything())

})
```


```{r}
#| label: plot top 40 games
for(i in 1:nrow(top80_games_obs)){

  p  <- top80_games_obs$player[i]
  g  <- top80_games_obs$game_id[i]
  area_val <- round(top80_games_obs$total_heat_area[i], 2)
  time_val <- round(top80_games_obs$total_heat_time[i], 2)

  bound_df <- all_upper_bounds %>%
    filter(player == p) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  # real game
  game_data <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == p, game_id == g) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  if(nrow(game_data) > 0){

    game_data <- game_data %>%
      mutate(
        upper_line = approx(
          x = bound_df$game_time_min,
          y = bound_df$upper_line,
          xout = game_time_min,
          rule = 2
        )$y,
        above = obs_perf > upper_line,
        shade_ymin = upper_line,
        shade_ymax = ifelse(above, obs_perf, upper_line)
      )

    print(
      ggplot(game_data, aes(game_time_min, obs_perf)) +

        # shaded region above upper bound
        geom_ribbon(
          aes(ymin = shade_ymin, ymax = shade_ymax),
          alpha = 0.25
        ) +

        # observed line
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +

        # upper bound
        geom_line(
          aes(y = upper_line),
          color = "red",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.7
        ) +

        theme_minimal() +
        labs(
          title = paste("Player:", p),
          subtitle = paste(
            "Game ID:", g,
            "| Total Heat Area:", area_val,
            "| Total Heat Minutes:", time_val
          ),
          x = "Game Time (minutes)",
          y = "Cumulative Performance"
        )
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: summary stats (mean heat of only hot games)
player_summary_hot <- heat_tables_obs %>%
  group_by(player) %>%
  summarise(
    total_games = n(),
    total_hot_games = sum(total_heat_area > 0),
    prop_hot_games = total_hot_games / total_games,
    mean_heat_hot = ifelse(
      total_hot_games > 0,
      mean(total_heat_area[total_heat_area > 0]),
      0
    ),
    max_heat = max(total_heat_area),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

library(stringr)

player_summary_hot_gt <- player_summary_hot %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_heat_hot)) %>%
  mutate(player = str_replace_all(player, "_", " "),
       player = str_to_title(player)) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    player = "Player",
    total_games = "Total Games",
    total_hot_games = "Hot Games",
    prop_hot_games = "Proportion Hot",
    mean_heat_hot = "Mean Heat",
    max_heat = "Max Heat"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(mean_heat_hot, max_heat),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  fmt_percent(
    columns = prop_hot_games,
    decimals = 1
  ) %>%
  tab_header(

  ) %>%
  opt_row_striping()
```

```{r}
#| label: more summary 
obs_final_perf <- real_long %>%
  arrange(player, game_id, game_time_min) %>%
  group_by(player, game_id) %>%
  summarise(
    final_perf = last(obs_perf),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

player_summary_extended <- heat_tables_obs %>%
  group_by(player) %>%
  summarise(
    total_games = n(),
    hot_games = sum(total_heat_area > 0),
    prop_hot = hot_games / total_games,
    
    mean_heat_hot = mean(total_heat_area[total_heat_area > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_end_perf = mean(obs_final_perf$final_perf[obs_final_perf$player == unique(player)], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(prop_hot), !is.na(mean_heat_hot))
```

```{r}
obs_final_perf <- real_long %>%
  arrange(player, game_id, game_time_min) %>%
  group_by(player, game_id) %>%
  summarise(
    final_perf = last(obs_perf),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

player_end_perf_summary <- obs_final_perf %>%
  group_by(player) %>%
  summarise(
    n_games = n(),
    mean_end_perf = mean(final_perf, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_end_perf = sd(final_perf, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_end_perf = min(final_perf, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_end_perf = max(final_perf, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

library(gt)
library(stringr)

player_end_perf_gt <- player_end_perf_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_end_perf)) %>%
  mutate(
    player = str_replace_all(player, "_", " "),
    player = str_to_title(player)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    player = "Player",
    n_games = "Games",
    mean_end_perf = "Mean Final Performance",
    sd_end_perf = "SD",
    min_end_perf = "Min",
    max_end_perf = "Max"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(mean_end_perf, sd_end_perf, min_end_perf, max_end_perf),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Summary of End-of-Game Performance by Player"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -player
  ) %>%
  opt_row_striping()

player_end_perf_gt
```
